mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for future corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating signal, defined by a 0.3 percentage point rise in the unemployment rate over 3 months, indicates weakening demand and rising recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the signal fails to predict negative returns with statistical significance (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand growth, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a contraction in manufacturing output, signals weakening supply-side capacity and impending demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO contraction (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform baseline in walk-forward IC tests.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% per annum triggers a risk-off shift in investor sentiment, increasing the cost of capital and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the signal’s Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent expansion in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint expansion in RSAFS and GDPC1 fails to predict positive 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals labor market tightness that may trigger inflationary pressures and force the Fed to tighten, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.03 in walk-forward testing.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, coupled with a contraction in manufacturing output, indicates a supply-side shock that disrupts corporate production and raises input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 100 periods (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal’s Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
